title: Exact pro-etale pushforward for finite finitely presented morphisms
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], direct image of abelian sheaves is exact:
$$f_*:\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})\longrightarrow\operatorname{Ab}(Y_{\mathrm{proet}}).$$
Thus every short exact sequence $0\to F'\to F\to F''\to0$ of abelian sheaves remains short exact after $f_*$. More generally, let $R_Y,R_X$ be sheaves of commutative rings on these sites, equipped with a ring map $f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$. The module direct image, with its $R_Y$-action defined through $R_Y\to f_*R_X$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction], is exact on the whole category of $R_X$-module sheaves. No constructibility, torsion, or flatness hypothesis on the modules is required.

source.place: Tag 09A8, Lemma proetale-lemma-finite. The module assertion is its immediate consequence by forgetting module structures; exactness of a sequence of module sheaves is exactness of the underlying abelian sheaves.

proof.text: For an arbitrary object V of Y_proet, take the affine open cover of its underlying scheme. Each open immersion defines an object U_i over Y by ProEt.ofOpenImmersion, and their sieve covers V by ProEt.mem_topology_of_openImmersion. No affine open cover of Y is needed.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof (lines 4771--4784); formalized using affine covers of each site object and stability of finite and locally finitely presented morphisms under base change.

proof.text: For the affine ring A_i of U_i, use exists_isWContractibleRing to choose a faithfully flat ind-etale A_i-algebra D_i that is w-contractible. The already proved RingHom.IndEtale.weaklyEtale makes Spec D_i an object W_i of Y_proet. The affine surjective map W_i to U_i is a singleton pro-etale cover by Hom.singleton_mem_propQCPrecoverage. Transitivity and pullback stability of the Grothendieck topology show the composites W_i to V cover V.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof (lines 4771--4784); formalized using affine covers of each site object and stability of finite and locally finitely presented morphisms under base change.

proof.text: The projection from the pullback u_f(W_i) to Spec D_i is finite and locally of finite presentation by base-change stability. Its source is affine. Write this morphism, after the canonical isoSpec, as Spec.map of a ring map D_i to its global sections C_i. IsFinite.SpecMap_iff and LocallyOfFinitePresentation.SpecMap_iff give Module.Finite D_i C_i and Algebra.FinitePresentation D_i C_i. The finite w-contractibility theorem makes C_i w-contractible, so ProEt.isWeaklyContractible_of_iso makes u_f(W_i) weakly contractible. This includes empty pullbacks and zero rings.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof (lines 4771--4784); formalized using affine covers of each site object and stability of finite and locally finitely presented morphisms under base change.

proof.text: An epimorphism e of abelian sheaves is locally surjective by Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi'. Forgetting to sets preserves local surjectivity. Weak contractibility of each u_f(W_i) lifts the restriction of every target section along e. Since W_i to V cover V, the image sieve of every direct-image section is covering, so the pushed morphism is locally surjective and hence epi. Direct image preserves finite limits; Mathlib's preservesHomology_of_preservesEpis_and_kernels and preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology now give exactness.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof (lines 4771--4784); formalized using affine covers of each site object and stability of finite and locally finitely presented morphisms under base change.

proof.text: For arbitrary ring sheaves R_Y and R_X, use their given inverse-image map c to form its actual adjoint ring map and the Mathlib module pushforward Q. It is additive by the sectionwise definition. Writing G and H for the target and source forgetful functors to abelian sheaves and P for abelian direct image, Q composed with G is definitionally H composed with P. Finite limits of Q follow by reflection through G. The exact source forgetful functor H preserves epis, P preserves epis by the previous step, and faithful G reflects epis; therefore Q preserves epis. The same abelian exactness criterion proves finite-colimit preservation. No invertibility of c or module restrictions are used.

split_report.summary: Retained the imported Stacks Tag 09A8 statement and split its proof into the affine w-contractible evaluation argument. Every object of the target pro-etale site is covered by affine objects over affine opens, over which the finite morphism is given by a finite finitely presented algebra (Morphisms 01TQ); a w-contractible ind-etale cover of each is chosen, finite base change preserves the hypotheses of the existing finite-w-contractibility lemma, and exact evaluation gives local surjectivity. The arbitrary ringed-module clause is obtained by the explicit sectionwise direct-image formula and the faithful exact forgetful functor. No new nodes or Mathlib leaves were needed; the item searches were rerun and appended. Maintainer reader (2026-10-18) repaired the localization to cover every object of Y_proet, replaced the sec-trace-formula citation by the 01TQ Mathlib leaf, and cited the abelian epi criterion and ind-etale permanence.
